newsitem.title: UK: Vendome buys watchmaker Officine Panerai.
newsitem.headline: Vendome buys watchmaker Officine Panerai.

text.p: Luxury goods maker Vendome Luxury Group Plc said on Tuesday it had bought the watches business of Italy's Officine Panerai for 1.0 million stg cash.

The purchase includes watch trademarks and patents for Officine Panerai, which specialises in underwater watches. Vendome said it would set up a research and development centre in Italy called Officine Panerai - Marketing and Communication.
Vendome is 70 percent-owned by South African-controlled Richemont Securities and was created three years ago from the rationalisation of Richemont AG, Dunhill Holdings and Rothmans International.
